claim_boundary: This is frozen dataset-label preprocessing, not gate evaluation.
No threshold may be changed after pixel outputs are inspected without a prospective amendment.
Processing raw frames that may later belong to DEV or TEST is allowed because split construction has not occurred and no SAM/gate outcome is used.
This configuration does not itself complete the whole-scene labels; manual disagreement adjudication and the frozen 30-event audit remain required.
freeze_principle: All thresholds and matching rules are fixed before inspecting full-corpus pixel outputs.

global_frame_difference.event_windows: adjacent transitions ending within disappear_min-2 through disappear_max+2 OR reappear_min-2 through reappear_max+2
global_frame_difference.reference_frames: exact five frames immediately preceding disappear_min
global_frame_difference.reference_statistic: median of the four adjacent-frame MAD values inside the five-frame reference window
global_frame_difference.statistic: mean absolute adjacent-frame RGB difference divided by 255

input_population.scope: collapsed EXP019 annotation-side whole-scene candidate scenes only

manual_audit.population: EXP019 collapsed annotation-side whole-scene candidate scenes
manual_audit.report: manual whole-scene judgement, automated two-signal label, agreement count and agreement rate
manual_audit.sampling: uniform without replacement using sorted scene_event_id population before pixel outcomes are inspected

outputs_required: per-scene pixel statistics and component decisions
final automated-confirmed scene list before adjudication

pixel_confirmation.automatic_final_ws_rule: EXP019 annotation candidate AND pixel_confirmation positive
pixel_confirmation.disagreement_rule: EXP019 annotation candidate AND pixel_confirmation negative -> MANUAL_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED
pixel_confirmation.pixel_positive_without_annotation_candid: outside this cross-check population and cannot independently create a whole-scene label

purpose: Independent pixel-side confirmation of EXP019 whole-scene annotation candidates before final dataset split

camera_cut.matching_rule: positive if any single-frame probability > 0.5 within disappear_min-2 through disappear_max+2 OR reappear_min-2 through reappear_max+2, clipped to video bounds

temporal_inference.end_padding_rule: repeat last frame using official TransNetV2 predict_frames formula
